about: Hi，我是赵润涵，目前就读深圳大学，这里记录我的学习、项目与日常活动，也欢迎浏览我的相册主页呀！我的研究兴趣包括光学神经网络、非线性光学等，欢迎与我交流！
aboutEn: Hi, I’m Roy Zhao, a student at Shenzhen University. This is where I share my studies, projects, and everyday activities. You’re also welcome to explore my photography site! My research interests include optical neural networks and nonlinear optics. Feel free to get in touch!
